explication: crates.io is the official Rust package registry, with a Rust/Axum backend, Diesel-backed data access, a SvelteKit frontend, and a custom background-worker system. A user-facing request enters the server, is routed to domain controllers, and can read or update registry data; publishing, authentication, and package discovery are distinct domain capabilities. Workers handle asynchronous maintenance and registry tasks. The README establishes the product and major technologies; the sampled server and session code show some wiring, while many controller and worker relationships are represented only at subsystem level.
